# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment

The verified baseline passes simulation and uses 15 LUTs and 6 FFs, but routed setup WNS is −0.946 ns; hold WHS is +0.167 ns. Iteration 1 was rejected with no surviving candidate, and the supplied outcome does not identify a verified candidate or its metrics. Timing recovery is the first priority; LUT reduction is assessed only after timing is feasible.

## Hypothesis

Adding registered head data and marker outputs should remove the read-pointer-to-distributed-RAM-to-output path and improve routed setup slack, at the cost of WIDTH+1 FFs; the routed report will show whether that gain closes timing.

## Instruction for generator

In `packet_fifo_core`, retain the circular `data_mem`/`last_mem`, read and write pointers, and occupancy logic, but add head data and marker registers that directly drive `out_data` and `out_last`. Load the head on an enqueue into an empty FIFO, and on a dequeue load the next queued tuple; handle a simultaneous dequeue and enqueue when occupancy is one by loading the new input tuple as the head. Preserve stalls, reset behavior, full simultaneous pop/push, all supported WIDTH and DEPTH values, and the top’s `// @latency 1` annotation and observable cycle behavior.
